stories.title: Trump-Xi summit: what's on the agenda, and why it matters
stories.summary: Xi Jinping's first US state visit in over a decade culminates Thursday in White House talks with Donald Trump on trade, AI, Taiwan and Iran. The two sides extended their trade truce until Jan. 10, setting up talks that top US tech executives will attend at a state dinner.

stories.title: Trump and Xi head into Washington summit with time on their side
stories.summary: The two leaders sit down Thursday with a long list of disagreements, from Taiwan arms sales to chip export controls. Both sides this week extended a one-year trade truce due Nov. 10 for two more months, deferring the harder deal-making.

stories.title: Xi arrives in US to personal Trump welcome
stories.summary: Trump greeted Xi personally on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews, honoring the Chinese leader with a red-carpet military welcome not extended to most visiting heads of state. The three-day visit aims to ease tensions across AI, trade and Iran, and closes with Thursday's White House talks and state dinner.

stories.title: Columbus man who pleaded guilty in deadly road-rage shooting retains new counsel
stories.summary: A Columbus man who earlier pleaded guilty in a deadly I-670 road-rage shooting has hired new legal counsel as he seeks to reverse his plea. The case stems from a shooting authorities linked to the November 2024 death and a separate indictment for murder.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov: Arena gets a free weekend Sept 24-27
stories.summary: Battlestate Games is offering free access to Escape from Tarkov: Arena from September 24 through 27, letting new players try the spin-off arena shooter. It comes as the studio continues to roll out its League System and season content for the wider Tarkov universe.
